command: async (page) => { const tasks=[];const h=r=>{if(r.url().includes('/loops/batch')&&r.request().method()==='POST')tasks.push(r.json().then(body=>({status:r.status(),request:r.request().postDataJSON(),body})));};page.on('response',h);await page.getByTestId('btn-dry-run').click();await page.getByTestId('btn-confirm-execute').click();await page.getByTestId('btn-review-restore').waitFor();page.off('response',h);const results=await Promise.all(tasks);if(results.length!==2||results.some(r=>r.status!==200))throw new Error('pin batch');return {results,summary:await page.getByTestId('batch-summary').innerText()}; }
